claim_boundary: Provisional PINDER-train-only antibody adaptation split closure iteration. It is not authorized for training or model selection until the independent exhaustive exact four-view Needleman-Wunsch audit reports zero qualifying train-validation crossings. It is not a performance evaluation, temporal test, structural split, or PLM pretraining leakage audit.

determinism.largest_component_tie_break: highest original exact-pair degree, then lexical component root

discard_policy: Discard a complete PDB-and-exact-pair connected component whenever its antibody and antigen axis components are assigned to different buckets. Never split a PDB or exact antibody-antigen sequence pair across train, validation, and discarded ledgers.
iteration_rule: Merge all 214 authenticated digest-only threshold crossings from iteration 2 into the existing component closure, rerun the unchanged binary MILP, and independently audit the new train-validation boundary. If new crossings remain, repeat without relaxing 80/80 or reading labels, structures, predictions, scores, external validation, or test data.
objective: maximize retained unique exact antibody-antigen sequence pairs across train and validation
required_final_gate: independent exhaustive exact global four-view Needleman-Wunsch train-validation zero-crossing audit
